strings.name: James Quincey
strings.role: Coca-Cola executive chairman and former CEO
strings.summary: British executive James Quincey joined Coca-Cola in 1996 and held leadership roles in Latin America and Europe. He became CEO in 2017 and chairman in 2019, promoting beverage diversification. In March 2026, he handed the CEO role to Henrique Braun and became executive chairman.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Birth is confirmed only to January 1965. CEO, president, COO and executive chairman are distinguished, as are succession announcement and effective dates.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Coca-Cola, promoting beverage diversification and changes in global brand management.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned a bachelor’s degree in electronic engineering from the University of Liverpool; no MBA or doctorate is inferred.
strings.facts.f2.label: External directorship
strings.facts.f2.value: Joined Pfizer’s board in 2020 and remains listed in his current official biography; board membership does not imply a drug-development role.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Beverage diversification
strings.highlights.h1.text: During his CEO tenure, Coca-Cola completed the Costa acquisition, expanding its coffee business.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Leadership succession
strings.highlights.h2.text: Henrique Braun succeeded him as CEO in 2026; Quincey continued as executive chairman.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Became executive chairman
strings.timeline.t1.text: Henrique Braun took over as CEO; Quincey left that role and continued to lead the board.
strings.timeline.t2.title: CEO succession announced
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company announced a handover for March 31 of the following year; the announcement did not mean an immediate departure.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Joined Pfizer’s board
strings.timeline.t3.text: Elected a director with immediate effect, distinct from an operational or research leadership role at Pfizer.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Also became Coca-Cola chairman
strings.timeline.t4.text: Added the chairmanship to his CEO responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Costa acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: Coca-Cola completed its acquisition of Costa from Whitbread, following the deal announced in 2018.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became Coca-Cola CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: Began serving as chief executive, continuing until the March 2026 handover.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Appointed president and COO
strings.timeline.t7.text: His COO tenure ended in April 2017, while his presidency continued through December 2018.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined Coca-Cola
strings.timeline.t8.text: Became director of learning strategy for the Latin America Group in Atlanta, later moving into regional operating roles.
